title: Direct login — a Central Bank operator obtains a session cookie
description: POST /api/v1/auth/login for a role that logs in directly (ROLE_GOVERNANCE, ROLE_SUPERVISOR, ROLE_NOC, ROLE_GOVERNANCE_OFFICER). The body carries the tokens and Set-Cookie installs the HttpOnly access_token and refresh_token cookies. The session is ready to use.
notes: Gateway: BCCR (Banco Central de Costa Rica) Central Bank gateway, spoke-crc. The server chooses the flow from the participant record — a client cannot select it; a commercial bank sending this same request gets the nonce body of mock-auth-hp-02 instead. Both tokens here are literal placeholders, not JWTs; no credential in this kit is real.
